overlaps.rationale: An appointment reminder is a notice sent to prompt attendance at a scheduled appointment; an appointment is the scheduled meeting itself.
A reminder is a specific notice prompting someone about an appointment, whereas a notice is generic written information intended to inform people.
A booking confirmation confirms that a reservation exists; an appointment reminder prompts the recipient before the scheduled appointment.
A notification is a broad alert from an application or service; an appointment reminder is specifically a notice about a scheduled appointment.
